title: Deroyal Industries, Inc. Lafollette recalls DeRoyal Procedure Packs containing Smiths Medical NORMOFLO Irrigation Warming: deroyal manufactured procedure packs containing a smiths medical normoflo irrigation warming (Class I, device)
summary: DeRoyal manufactured procedure packs containing a Smiths Medical NORMOFLO Irrigation Warming System which is recalled due to the potential for aluminum ions leaching into warming fluids. Product: DeRoyal Procedure Packs containing Smiths Medical NORMOFLO Irrigation Warming Set Status: Terminated.

title: Vero Biotech recalls GENOSYL DS (Delivery System) console, for use as a vasodilator.: manufacturing defect involving reversal of the inlet and outlet gas lines, resulting in delivery (Class I, device)
summary: Manufacturing defect involving reversal of the inlet and outlet gas lines, resulting in delivery of nitrogen dioxide (NO2) instead of nitric oxide (NO). Product: GENOSYL DS (Delivery System) console, for use as a vasodilator. Status: Completed.

title: Supreme Court: City of Tahlequah v. Bond
summary: Officers Girdner and Vick are entitled to qualified immunity in this excessive force action brought under 42 U. S. C. §1983; the Tenth Circuit’s contrary holding is not based on a single precedent finding a Fourth Amendment violation under similar circumstances. (No. 20-1668, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 595 U.S. 9).

title: Supreme Court: Rivas-Villegas v. Cortesluna
summary: Officer Rivas-Villegas is entitled to qualified immunity in this excessive force action brought under 42 U. S. C. §1983; the Ninth Circuit’s holding that Circuit precedent “put him on notice that his conduct constituted excessive force” is reversed. (No. 20-1539, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 595 U.S. 1).
